title: Register Agent Plan on the official MCP registry
summary: Publish the Agent Plan MCP server listing to registry.modelcontextprotocol.io.
description:
Register the Agent Plan MCP server on the official Model Context Protocol registry so it is discoverable by MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Zed, Cursor, etc.) without requiring a harness-specific plugin or extension.

Context:
- The MCP registry is at https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/ and is currently in public preview.
- Agent Plan already distributes `@agent-plan/mcp` via npm and documents setup for Claude Code, Codex, and Zed.
- The registry is a public listing/catalog, separate from npm distribution.

Files likely involved:
- New registry manifest/YAML under the official MCP registry repo (external PR).
- README.md / docs — update with registry badge or install-from-registry instructions once published.
- packages/agent-plan CLI or docs — possibly add a command to generate/copy registry metadata.

Open questions:
- Exact registry submission format (YAML/JSON schema, PR process).
- Whether the registry requires a hosted remote MCP server or accepts stdio command entries.
- Version pinning and update cadence.

Out of scope for this phase:
- Building new harness plugins/extensions.
- Changing the MCP server protocol implementation (stdio remains the transport).

tasks.title: Add Agent Plan to the official MCP registry
tasks.description:
Submit a listing for the Agent Plan MCP server to the official Model Context Protocol registry (https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/).

Background:
- The registry is a public catalog of MCP servers maintained by Anthropic, currently in preview.
- It is separate from npm distribution: npm holds the code, the registry holds the discoverable listing.
- Agent Plan is already distributed as `@agent-plan/mcp` on npm and documented for Claude Code, Codex, and Zed.

Work items:
1. Read the current registry submission docs at https://modelcontextprotocol.io/registry/about and the registry repo (https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry) to determine the required manifest format and PR process.
2. Prepare registry metadata (name, description, homepage, runtime, command, env, tool summary, categories/tags).
3. Open a PR against the official registry repo.
4. Update project docs (README.md or docs/setup-*.md) to mention installation via the MCP registry once the listing is live.

Acceptance:
- Agent Plan appears in the MCP registry search/listing.
- Docs reference the registry as an install option.
- Existing npm and per-harness setup docs remain accurate.

Notes:
- Do not implement a remote/SSE MCP server; Agent Plan remains stdio-only.
- The registry listing should point clients to `npx agent-plan mcp` (or `npx -y @agent-plan/mcp`) as the local command.

---
**Completion summary:**
Prepared @agent-plan/mcp for official MCP registry: added mcpName io.github.ovidius72/agent-plan to packages/plan-mcp/package.json, created packages/plan-mcp/server.json manifest, included server.json in npm package files. Build and type-check clean. Final publish to registry.modelcontextprotocol.io requires maintainer to run `npx mcp-publisher login github && npx mcp-publisher publish` in packages/plan-mcp (documented in CHECKLIST.md).
